name: Path of the Valkyrie
source:
A mysterious artifact suddenly transports you to Asgard's fjord-riddled lands. What does Odin, leader of the Aesir and guardian of worlds, want from you? And what is sly Loki up to in the shadows?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Path_of_the_Valkyrie]romance-club.fandom[/url]
